name: piotroski-f-score
notes: Piotroski (2000) F-Score: 9-component binary quality score. Profitability: ROA>0, OCF>0, ROA improving, OCF>NI. Leverage/liquidity: LTD/TA decreasing, current ratio improving, no dilution. Efficiency: gross margin improving, asset turnover improving. Sector-neutral top 20% by F-score, monthly rebalance.
